row:
Welcome to Physical Therapy Session.
I will provide you information and ideas to help you take control of your body with simplified rehabilitation breakdown. I will help you reduce or eliminate pain, avoid surgery, improve mobility and guide you to an exercise program fitting for your unique condition.

I will also be having a YouTube LIVE at least once a month for a virtual consultation/counselling. You can seek advice and information.
Stay Tuned.
Don't forget to SUBSCRIBE and hit the bell button to stay updated for any new videos coming up! 

****Disclaimer****
The content of this channel should not be used to self-diagnose or self-treat any health, medical, or physical condition. Don’t use this content to avoid going to your own healthcare professional or to replace the advice they give you. Consult with your healthcare professional before doing anything contained in this channel.
Use of the content posted here are completely at your sole risk!
